input_devices.description: List of input event device paths (e.g., `/dev/input/event0`) to monitor for IR events. Leave empty to auto-detect devices.

items.description: Path to an input event device (e.g., `/dev/input/event0`).

driver.description: LIRC driver to use. Use 'uinput' for zeroconf operation (creates a virtual LIRC device).

lirc_device.description: Path to the LIRC device socket. Must be writable by the `user` and accessible by LIRC clients.

options.description: Additional command-line options to pass to the `inputlirc` daemon (e.g., `--debug --dry-run`).

user.description: System user account under which the `inputlirc` daemon runs. Must have permission to read the input devices and write to the LIRC socket path.

group.description: System group for the `inputlirc` daemon. Ensures correct permissions on the LIRC socket.

auto_reload.description: Enable automatic restart/reload of the daemon when input devices are added or removed (e.g., USB IR receiver plugged in).
